rubric.description: Dimensions derived from Glocal Teen Hero's own stated criteria (leadership, innovation & technology, social impact, creativity, community contribution, 'beyond academics') plus the organizer's public write-ups of why past winners won. Each dimension is scored 0-5 from public information. Weights sum to 1.0.

social_impact.definition: Scale and measurability of positive change for people/community.

leadership.definition: Founding/leading organizations, teams, movements; mentoring others.

innovation.definition: Technical depth and novelty of what was actually built.

recognition.definition: External, verifiable credibility: media, awards, credits, CVEs.

glocal_fit.definition: Global-grade work that stays rooted in local (Nepal/South Asia) impact.

character.definition: Self-drive, resilience, initiative, will to learn.

heroes.name: Pranjal Chalise
heroes.title: Wai Wai Glocal Teen Hero Nepal 2021
heroes.summary: Technopreneur and independent researcher. Built Drishti Nepal, an open-source cross-platform app helping visually impaired people recognize currency and do daily cash transactions; also an agriculture-information app and a women-safety app.

heroes.name: Rahul Ranjan Sah
heroes.title: Wai Wai Glocal Teen Hero Nepal 2022
heroes.summary: Astropreneur, astronomer and researcher. Founding member of Student Development and Exploration in Space (SXC); works on 'Arohan', a venture aiming to commercialize and develop Nepal's first private space mission. Affiliated with Nepal Astronomical Society.

heroes.name: Shruti Tiwari
heroes.title: Golchha Group presents Glocal Teen Hero Nepal 2023
heroes.summary: Environment and child-rights activist. Led the Plasticman Campaign against single-use plastic and tree-planting efforts exceeding 100,000 trees (with Save the Children, WWF Nepal); documented impact stopping 12 child marriages and 3 child-abuse cases; mentored ~20 Dalit/Janjati girls; featured by BBC UK.

heroes.name: Ghanashyam Bishwakarma
heroes.title: Golchha Group presents Glocal Teen Hero Nepal 2024
heroes.summary: Activist with 8+ years advocating children's rights, mental health, climate justice and against child marriage. Leads the National Adolescents Boys Network Nepal, runs workshops on child sexual exploitation, and coordinates disaster relief.

heroes.name: Aarjan Chaudhary
heroes.title: Applicant, Glocal Teen Hero South Asia 2026
heroes.summary: Self-taught security engineer ('Youngest Hacker of Nepal'). Research credited by Google, Twitch, EA, Stanford, XCI; assigned CVE-2025-51588 (among the youngest to receive one). Security engineer at Dench (YC S24). Founder of kroda.ai (AI penetration-testing product with $20,000+ in binding LOIs from YC/IPO-listed startups). Founder of Arniko Hack Club, Nepal's largest teen tech community (400+ members, top-10 teen non-profit in Asia); organized Daydream (250+) and Campfire (150+) hackathons and the InventNovelty hacker house. One prior startup exit (ggamechamps, acquired).
